## SBC Medical to Announce 3Q 2026 Financial Results


2026-11-03


**SBC Medical to Announce 3Q 2026 Financial Results**


Earnings conference call to be held on November 13, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time


IRVINE, Calif. –SBC Medical Group Holdings Incorporated (Nasdaq: SBC) (“The Company” or “SBC Medical”), a Medical Services Organization (MSO) providing management support across a wide range of healthcare fields, today announced that it will release its financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, before U.S. market open on November 13, 2026.


Management will host an earnings conference call on November 13, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time. A question-and-answer session with investors and analysts will follow the prepared remarks.


Please register in advance for the conference using the link provided below.


\[[https://zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_CLFqOL3XTourhX2qjAJnxw](https://zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_CLFqOL3XTourhX2qjAJnxw) \]


Additionally, the earnings release, accompanying slides, and an archived webcast of this conference call will be available at the Company’s Investor Relations website at https://ir.sbc-holdings.com/


**About SBC Medical Group Holdings Incorporated**


SBC Medical is a Medical Services Organization providing management support across a wide range of healthcare fields, including advanced aesthetic healthcare, dermatology, orthopedics, fertility treatment, gynecology, dentistry, hair loss treatment (AGA), and ophthalmology. The Company manages a diverse portfolio of clinic brands and is actively expanding its global presence, particularly in the United States and Asia, through both direct operations and medical tourism initiatives. In September 2024, the Company was listed on Nasdaq, and in June 2025, it was selected for inclusion in the Russell 3000® Index, a broad benchmark of the U.S. equity market. Guided by its Group Purpose “Contributing to the well-being of people around the world through medical innovation,” SBC Medical Group Holdings Incorporated continues to provide safe, trusted, and high-quality medical services while further strengthening its international reputation for quality and trust in medical care.


For more information, visit https://sbc-holdings.com


For more insights and updates from SBC Medical, follow us on[LinkedIn.](https://www.linkedin.com/company/sbc-medical-group-holdings-inc/?viewAsMember=true)
